# Rupert Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** Nine or ten years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c31 P20](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0020)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rupert  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Rupert possesses his deceased mother's unafraid, straightforward, luminous, dark-blue eyes and golden-glinted brown hair. During a bout of severe illness, he experienced flushed cheeks, a throbbing head, and a sore throat.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c10 P29](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0029)_

## Personality

Rupert is a brave, cheerful, and mischievous boy with an absolute obsession for collecting bugs, frogs, toads, and other insects. He is highly curious and entertained by unusual occurrences, yet shows a courageous, considerate attitude toward his family. He cares deeply for his father and is willing to endure hardship without crying to avoid causing him distress.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c14 P9](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0009), [v5 c33 P27](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0027)_

## History

Rupert spent his childhood at the manse in Glen St. Agnes, often engaging in playful games with his siblings, such as playing leap-frog across gravestones or sliding down the hall banisters. He frequently captured various creatures, once scaring a visitor when a large toad he hid under a couch leaped out at her feet. After getting soaked while chasing dragonflies in Fern Hollow marsh, he fell dangerously ill with double pneumonia, though he eventually recovered under doctor's care. Following a churchyard gathering, he joined his siblings in forming a Good-Conduct Club to discipline themselves and avoid causing trouble for their father. When he faced a deserved whipping from his father for misbehavior, Rupert courageously resolved not to cry so as not to cause his father distress.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 c10 P18](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0018), [v5 c14 P9](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0009), [v5 c14 P30](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0030), [v5 c23 P70](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0070), [v5 c31 P27](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0027), [v5 c33 P23](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0023), [v5 c33 P27](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0027)_
